biotools.summary: YOLO-Starfish is an object detection model built upon YOLOv8, specifically designed for identifying fish in complex underwater environments. It comes with the Underwater Freshwater Fish Dataset (UFFD) to support training and benchmarking.
biotools.name: YOLO-Starfish: Fish Object Detection
